evals.prompt: Run the daily Nattome TikTok batch analysis for today.
evals.expected_output: A timestamped runs/batch-analysis/<timestamp>_daily folder containing raw scrape JSON, Daily Top Videos handoff JSON, selected batch artifacts, source-video snapshots, Gemini evidence artifacts when credentials are available, final Nattome POV report Markdown files when generated, and Telegram delivery status in the manifest.

assertions.text: Runs batch_analysis/run_batch_analysis.py against the Daily Top Videos handoff using the same timestamp
Reports raw scrape path, daily selection path, run folder path, final output paths, and run_manifest.json phase status
Does not claim Gemini or Telegram phases completed when credentials are missing

evals.prompt: Summarize the latest Nattome batch-analysis run and tell me whether the final reports were delivered.
evals.expected_output: A concise artifact and phase-status summary grounded in the latest run_manifest.json, including selected count, source-video states, Gemini report status, final_outputs, and telegram_delivery status.

assertions.text: Reads run_manifest.json instead of inferring phase success from file names alone
Preserves source video states exactly as available, missing, or failed
Treats Telegram delivery as separate from Gemini report generation
Lists generated Nattome POV report markdown paths only when present in final_outputs

evals.prompt: Use this existing candidate JSON to create a source-video batch-analysis run without scraping today.
evals.expected_output: A run folder created by batch_analysis/run_batch_analysis.py using the provided candidate JSON, with selected batch artifacts, source-video snapshots, Gemini status, and Telegram delivery status recorded in run_manifest.json.

assertions.text: Does not call Apify when an existing candidate JSON is supplied
Keeps selected candidate rank and source-video state unchanged in the summary
Does not invent creative recommendations from metadata when Gemini evidence is unavailable
